description.value: Heaven's Door Yurt is a casual yurt-style café set at the base of the Stairway to Heaven chairlift at Kicking Horse Mountain Resort near Golden, BC. It serves beverages, build-your-own hot dogs, grilled sandwiches, and more in a distinctive rustic shelter. The venue is well-positioned for mountain bikers and hikers exploring the resort's extensive trail network.
